experiments.explanation: I selected XGBoost with all eight measured features: validation AUC was 0.8544, versus 0.8303 using the three basic features. It predicts much faster than the frozen Sophon reference, which remains substantially more accurate. This is an unmodified workshop baseline for participants to improve.

latency_protocol.interpretation: Self-reported local CPU timing. The fixed numeric reference is an approximate hardware correction, not an equivalent model workload.
latency_protocol.reference_kernel: 64 float64 256x256 matrix products; seed 42; one BLAS thread; median of 3 after 1 warmup

experiments.reporting: Team-reported scores and timings; quality recomputed against fixed reference labels.

leaderboard.rules: Team awards compare trained models only. Supplied Sophon stays visible as a frozen reference. Efficiency requires AUC within 0.02 of the best trained final result; lower normalized time wins.
